name: Do I need an interior build-out or just a renovation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an interior build-out or just a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior build-out is usually for a new space or a complete transformation, creating a functional layout from a shell. A renovation typically involves updating or improving an existing space without fundamentally changing its layout or purpose. If your current space no longer meets your operational needs or you're starting fresh, a build-out is likely necessary. For aesthetic updates or minor functional improvements, a renovation might suffice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a build-out for new spaces or major layout changes; opt for renovation for aesthetic updates or minor improvements to an existing space.
